title: Mitigation & Preparation
welcome_lead: Compare DRR strategies in Japan and Philippines.
meta_desc: A-Level Geography adventure on tectonic mitigation, early warning and DRR.
final_note: Preparation transforms hazard into manageable risk.

concepts.def: Detect and broadcast warning; seconds to minutes for earthquakes.
Identifying risk zones for planning; USGS, JMA produce maps.
Seismic design: base isolation, dampers, ductile frames.
Drills like Japan's 1 September Bosai Day since 1960.
Spreads financial risk; CEA (California Earthquake Authority).
Restricting development in liquefaction or tsunami zones.

walkthroughs.body_html: EEW system gives 8-30 seconds warning via TV, mobile, trains. Tokyo SkyTree 634 m uses oil dampers + central concrete core. Bosai Day (1 September) drills since 1960. School-based education from age 5. Tsunami sea walls up to 15 m post-2011. Cost: $1.5 billion/yr DRR investment.

Typhoon Haiyan November 2013 Cat 5: 6300 deaths, 16 million affected. Pre-event PAGASA forecasts accurate but evacuation slow; storm surge 7 m at Tacloban. Post: Build Back Better with stronger schools (each typhoon-rated). Bangsamoro Disaster Risk Reduction Office established 2018.

Sendai 2015-2030 sets 7 global targets including reducing global disaster mortality. ODA for DRR reached $4.9 billion in 2020 but still <0.5 percent of total. UNDRR Words Into Action guidelines support implementation. Challenge: integrate climate adaptation with DRR.
